name: Evelyn Celebrían
original_name: イヴリン・ケレブリアン
source:
She was helped by the protagonist when she was kidnapped. To repay him for saving her, she now stays with him. She also happens to excel at all manners of housework.

While she is not good with dealing with others, she is the type to fawn over and devote herself to a person if they let their guard down.

[spoiler]1504 years old.[/spoiler]
